objective: Implement only the M380/M382-admitted bounded q32/O4 active-descriptor controller: exact zero-only compaction, canonical 48-bit descriptors, direct-address maximal PWP bursts, an in-order II1 descriptor read path with L1..8/D8 credit, tile1 payload prefetch overlapped with tile0 replay, exactly two replays, and sticky fail-closed recovery. Verify functional and protocol behavior in Synopsys VCS before any synthesis claim.

frozen_architecture.descriptor_layout_msb_to_lsb: row_id[11:0], original[15:0], center_id[6:0], distance[4:0], use_pwp[0], reserved[6:0]=0
frozen_architecture.fallback_rule: all other active rows, including population one, remain exact bit-sparse
frozen_architecture.descriptor_sram: external compact 48-bit payload; one write or one read request per cycle; no inferred physical macro claim
frozen_architecture.descriptor_read_order: strictly increasing compact address, in-order response
frozen_architecture.pwp_run_rule: maximal consecutive used center-ID run, no center remap
frozen_architecture.tile1_overlap: tile1 tagged payload prefetch starts atomically with tile0 replay and tile1 replay is blocked until tagged completion
frozen_architecture.sticky_protocol_error_recovery: reset or explicit legal configuration reload only where frozen; illegal same-cycle traffic is fail-closed

decision_rule.advance_to_independent_hammer: Only the exact-SHA Synopsys VCS run with every directed gate and coverpoint nonzero may be reviewed.
decision_rule.advance_to_dc: Only VCS PASS plus an independent M385 review with P0=0 and P1=0 may admit exploratory logic-only DC.
decision_rule.dc_boundary: Controller logic only at 3.0 ns using the available TSMC28 library; external descriptor/PWP SRAM macros, wires, clock tree and physical implementation remain excluded.

red_lines: M381's 1.0763828768x is a four-bottleneck-Conv module recurrence, not a full-network speedup.
Directed coverage counts are not workload populations or a performance result.
The bounded controller does not admit unbounded descriptors, a per-descriptor blocking datapath, or a remapped PWP cache.
Do not mix any lossy number into this exact milestone.
